_help: Hand-maintained. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. confirmed=false means the date came from listing sites, not the organiser - check before booking. book_by is about 3 weeks before the show (time to set up meetings).

events.name: Big 5 Global 2026
events.why: Biggest construction show in MEASA. Main contractors, MEP firms and developers who need site radios, repeaters and PTP links for site offices and CCTV.
events.note: On now. Walk the halls for contractor contacts.

events.name: GITEX Global 2026
events.venue: Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City Dubai
events.why: Moved to December and to Expo City this year. Government IT, telcos and system integrators - good for Cambium wireless broadband and smart-city/CCTV backhaul conversations.
events.note: Book-by date has passed - book meetings now.

events.name: Intersec Global 2027
events.why: The key show for us: security companies, guarding firms, police and civil defence buyers. Core audience for two-way radios, TETRA and body cameras.
events.note: Organiser pages show both 11-13 Jan and 12-14 Jan 2027 (12-14 is on the Intersec Global page and in WAM news). Check intersecglobal.ae before booking.

events.name: Arabian Travel Market 2027
events.why: Hotel groups, resorts, destination developers and tourism boards. Hotel ops and security teams run on radios - good for new-opening leads.

events.name: Critical Communications World (CCW) 2027
events.why: TCCA's global TETRA / mission-critical show. Useful for Motorola and TETRA network contacts; GCC operators (e.g. Nedaa) often attend.
events.note: UNCONFIRMED. Listing sites show Amsterdam 11-13 May 2027. I could not find a separate 'CCW Middle East' edition - the last Dubai edition was May 2024. Check tcca.info.

events.name: The Hotel Show Dubai 2027
events.why: Hotel owners, operators, procurement and pre-opening teams. Pre-opening teams buy radio fleets for housekeeping, security and engineering.
events.note: UNCONFIRMED. Dates from listing sites only; the 2026 show was moved to Sept, so check thehotelshow.com.

events.name: ADIPEC 2027
events.why: The region's biggest oil & gas show. ADNOC, Aramco, PDO, EPC contractors and drilling firms - buyers of ATEX radios and PTP links for remote sites.
events.note: Organiser says November 2027; exact 1-4 Nov dates come from listing sites.

events.name: Big 5 Global 2027
events.why: Same audience as this year: contractors, developers and MEP firms.
events.note: ESTIMATE ONLY. 2027 dates not announced; guessed from the usual late-November slot.

events.name: ISNR Abu Dhabi 2028
events.why: National security and resilience show, held every two years with the Ministry of Interior and Abu Dhabi Police. Government buyers, so check compliance before quoting.
events.note: UNCONFIRMED. Biennial - the last edition was 19-21 May 2026. 2028 dates from one listing site only.
